source_url: https://arxiv.org/e-print/2203.03647 (LaTeX source of Umetsu et al. 2022, ApJ 934, 169, arXiv:2203.03647)
exact_query: Table 9 ('X-ray model parameter constraints derived from forward modeling of Chandra observations'), file table9.tex in the arXiv e-print tarball for 2203.03647. Only the 7 cluster-emission parameters are transcribed; the 10 calibration nuisance parameters N_i are omitted.
extraction: Transcribed verbatim from the published LaTeX table (table9.tex). The kpc equivalents in the note column are the paper's own commented-out values in the LaTeX source. Raw table9.tex kept in raw_paper_tables/a370_umetsu2022_table9.tex.
note: Abell 370 (z=0.375), Chandra ACIS. ANALYTIC MODEL, not a tabulated profile. Forward fit (mbproj2, Sanders 2017) to Chandra X-ray SURFACE BRIGHTNESS profiles in 10 energy bands, 49 linearly spaced radial bins over theta in [10,200] arcsec = 51.6-1032 kpc. Functional forms (paper Eq. 8): n_e(r) = n_e0 * [1 + (r/r_c)^2]^(-3*beta/2)   [beta-model]; T_3D(r) = T_0 * (r/r_t)^a / [1 + (r/r_t)^2]^(c/2)   [Vikhlinin et al. 2006 form]. Both n_e(r) and T_3D(r) are 3D DEPROJECTED quantities, obtained by forward-projecting the 3D model and fitting the projected surface brightness, ASSUMING SPHERICAL SYMMETRY. Fit fixed z=0.375, N_H=2.89e20 cm^-2, Z=0.3 Zsun. NO core excision (fit starts at 10 arcsec). The paper ALSO derives a hydrostatic mass from these parameters - that M_HSE is NOT included here and must not be used as an observation.
